title: Schemin Data Freshness
description: Freshness receipt for a persisted gateway snapshot. Consumers must recompute effective age from fetched_at at read time; snapshot_age_seconds is the age known when this envelope was last persisted, not a perpetual clock.

stale.description: Persisted acquisition/degradation state. Consumers must also mark data stale when recomputed age exceeds their SLO.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last successful validated acquisition.

last_refresh_attempt_at.description: UTC timestamp of the latest acquisition attempt, successful or failed.

snapshot_age_seconds.description: Age recorded when the envelope was last persisted. Effective current age is recomputed from fetched_at.
